Use case: style-transfer. Produce ONE 16:9 1792x1024 or preferably 1920x1080 full-bleed game cinematic illustration, no borders. Image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE reference: match its very simple hand-drawn animation background, broad flat painted color planes, restrained brown-black outlines, matte surfaces, sparse wear, muted dark blue teal and warm cream/ochre, softly simplified architecture. Image 2 is CHARACTER/shape reference for rounded chunky game proportions, NOT a character to insert. Image 3 is CONTENT reference only: redraw its story, dramatically simplify all detail to match image 1. Do not replicate image 1 typography. No text, logos, letters, UI, glyphs or watermarks anywhere. Avoid photographic detail, tiny scratches, metallic photoreal highlights, 3D rendering, excessive greebles, wet glossy ground, fine crosshatching. Cinematic composition: main subject within upper 65% of the image; bottom 30% quieter dark foreground for live subtitles, but paint the full scene, no blank panels.
Scene: A large cream surveillance camera on left overhead with a single red lens slowly watches the viewer; simple beam of red light across a deserted industrial rail-city walkway, small rounded recovery machine in midground. Keep distant buildings simple like the title.
